notes:
Account summary: mid-market product analytics SaaS. Started with Hosted API POC to validate latency and embeddings relevance. POC positive — embeddings quality good, chat flows functional. Now shifting to Dedicated for predictable throughput and data isolation.

Key asks from customer (shorthand):
- Commit sizing: want 3-tier proposal (Small, Medium, Large) with committed GPU-hours / qps targets. Customer prefers ramp: 30% first month, 60% second, 100% by month 4.
- Burst: ability to burst to 2x committed capacity for short windows (max 72 hours/month) without provisioning extra reserved capacity. Need transparent billing for burst usage.
- Overage pricing: prefer capped overage % rather than pay-as-you-go; suggested model = base unit price + 50% uplift for overage tokens beyond commit.
- Ramp schedule & credits: asks for ramp credits for first 3 months while traffic stabilizes; suggested 20% credit first month, 10% second.
- SLA: 99.9% latency SLO for API routes; need fallbacks to hosted pool if Dedicated capacity saturates.
- Security: VPC private control plane, KMS integration (AWS KMS), SAML SSO, audit logs retention 1 year, data residency US only.

Commercial notes:
- Ran internal pricing simulation with Redwood Optimize: expected unit cost reduction 28% vs hosted at targeted batch settings.
- Finance pushed back on long-term commit without staged ramp and clear overage caps.
- Legal needs a statement of support for KMS + SOC2 evidences before signing.

Rep quotes from calls: "We need predictable bills — spikes kill our margins"; "If you can give a clean ramp + burst model we can justify the commit".

Open items: detailed Dedicated pricing table (three tiers), explicit burst policy text, example invoice for first 6 months with ramp credits, SOC2 package delivery date.

Short next steps: AE to get final pricing commitment from commercial (due 2026-03-18); SE to produce burst behavior doc and sample invoices; Legal to schedule SOC2 artifact handoff.
use_case_summary: Primary: in-product support assistant (chat) + semantic search over product telemetry (embeddings) + reranking user-generated content. Need sub-100ms token latency at 95th percentile on key routes; throughput target 300 reqs/min for peak flows.
commercial_summary: Requesting Dedicated contract with tiered commit (3 options). Preferred term: 12 months with 3-month ramp and burst allowances. Proposal seeks blended ARR in $150k-$450k range. Overages to be capped at 50% premium; ramp credits requested for first 2 months.
security_summary: VPC/private plane mandatory; AWS KMS integration required; SOC2 Type II evidence requested; SAML for SSO; log retention 12 months for audit. Data residency: US only.
objections_and_risks: Main risk: finance rejects long commit if overage exposure unclear. Secondary: legal delay on SOC2/HSM evidence could push close past forecast. Technical: need clear fallback routing to hosted pool to avoid downtime during Dedicated saturation.
next_meeting_proposed: 2026-03-18 commercial sync (AE + Finance + SE) to lock commit level and finalize SOW
